issue_context.title: Cannot apply the changes of the setting from resource manager
issue_context.body:
## Bug Report

`ltb-max-wait-duration` is changed in server side, but tidb (client-side) not apply the changes.
### 1. Minimal reproduce step (Required)

```
curl -X POST -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"ltb-max-wait-duration": "10m"}' http://127.0.0.1:2379/resource-manager/api/v1/config/controller
```
check the logs of tidb
### 2. What did you expect to see? (Required)
the log changes, the parameters change.

### 3. What did you see instead (Required)
not changed

### 4. What is your TiDB version? (Required)

<!-- Paste the output of SELECT tidb_version() -->

7.5

review_comments: We replace `LoadGlobalConfig` with `Get` in real resource control client, so need to impl `Get` in mock pd client
updated to the latest pd client in release-7.5
